subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw accept SourceActor/sourceActor as the public plugin, message, and memory attribution contract for this stack, including the scalar mirrors and best-effort privacy semantics, or require a narrower or renamed contract before release?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the PR creates public plugin-facing context and memory supplement fields that external plugins can rely on after release; automation cannot choose the long-term API naming or privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve SourceActor Contract
options.body: Treat this PR as the memory follow-up after the prerequisite Signal/source-actor stack lands and resolve draft/stack-order cleanup before merge.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow Contract
options.body: Ask for a revised API surface before release if maintainers want fewer scalar mirrors, different names, or stricter privacy boundaries.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close later if maintainers decide participant attribution should be structurally stored before being exposed as best-effort context.

recommendation.title: Approve SourceActor Contract
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as the memory follow-up after the prerequisite Signal/source-actor stack lands and resolve draft/stack-order cleanup before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across inbound context centralization, memory tool behavior, and plugin descriptor context near this public contract boundary.
